t: Merry - Definition, Meaning & Synonyms | Vocabulary.com
s: To be merry is to be happy, especially in a fun, festive way. Parties and celebrations are merry, and so are the fun people who attend them. This old fashioned word for “happy” is popular in December when people say, “Merry Christmas.”
